name: ebooksdepository
description: Find ebooks and audiobooks and the independent bookshops that carry them.

interface.longDescription: Search ebooks and audiobooks by title, author, publisher, or language; inspect catalog metadata and formats; and discover the independent bookshops that carry each title. EbooksDepository is a read-only index and never creates carts, places orders, processes payments, or states or estimates prices.
defaultPrompt: Find an ebook by Ursula K. Le Guin.
Which independent bookshops carry this title?
Show me audiobook bookshops in Mexico.
